notes.title: ♟️ New Update & 5 Years of BOT.vinnik! ♟️
notes.notes:
Hello, fellow chess enthusiasts!



Last week marked 5 years since the launch of the first game in our BOT.vinnik franchise! To celebrate this special milestone and reinforce our commitment to the series, we've released a new update for BOT.vinnik Chess: Combination Lessons, featuring several enhancements inspired by our latest project, BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy (available now for wishlist!)


Check out what's new:
🔊 New BOT.vinnik Reactions: We imported all the updated quotes and reactions directly from our newest game, making our beloved robot instructor even more expressive and sarcastic than ever.

✏️ Comprehensive Text Revision: Conducted a thorough review of all content, eliminating typos, improving syntax, and making texts clearer and more enjoyable.

🖥️ Windowed Mode: You can now easily switch between fullscreen and windowed mode by pressing ALT + ENTER.

🛠️ Bug Fixes: Addressed issues related to incorrectly swapped achievements.

📈 Gameplay Flow Improvements:

Clarified when clicks are necessary to proceed.

Immediate feedback for correct moves, removing the need to wait for previous incorrect comments.

🎨 Minor Visual Refinements: Subtle adjustments behind the chessboard for an improved visual experience.

🚀 New Splash Screen: Featuring our updated studio brand, Deep Green Games!


New Game: BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy!
Excited about these updates? There's something even bigger on the horizon! The demo for our latest project, BOT.VINNIK Chess Masters Academy, is almost ready, and you can already add it to your wishlist on Steam:



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820000/BOTVINNIK_Chess_Masters_Academy/"][/dynamiclink]

Your support means the world to us!



Thanks for the incredible 5 years, here's to many more.

— Deep Green Games Team.

notes.title: BIG UPDATE!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It's been a month since launch, and we are thrilled with the reception the game has had so far! Even our charming instructor is grateful!
As a way to thank all of you for the incredible support, we are releasing a major game update, containing:

- Achievements (everyone likes achievements, right? Or so we've heard)!
- 50% more content and TWO more chapters with brand new tactical themes.
- support for macOS! (included in the last few weeks)

We hope you like it and keep studying chess while having fun!

One last thing:
There's more BOT.vinnik on the way! Stay tuned!
